prompt:
Use case: edit/recreate a production CAPYBARA animation sprite atlas for the tiny desktop companion in Mew. Reference 1 is the user's screenshot: ONLY the central large tan capybara drawing is the visual-style reference, ignore all phone/browser UI, text, logos and other thumbnails. Reference 2 is the existing capybara idle strip, the edit target and species/asset reference. REPLACE its polished glossy cute appearance with a deliberately very simple, casually drawn, oblivious deadpan capybara like reference 1. The requested change is expressive and stylistic, not a filter.
Character design and drawing style: huge wide heavy bean-shaped tan-brown body, almost no neck, broad blocky drooping rounded rectangular muzzle, tiny round ears, tiny stubby feet with only two or three simple toe marks, no tail. Very SMALL widely spaced DARK HORIZONTAL DOT/DASH EYES set high and far apart. No white reflections, no shiny pupils, no big eyes, no eyebrows, no sparkling alert expression. Face looks vacant, absent-minded, dopey, mildly clueless, low-energy, calmly staring into space in EVERY action. Small oval nostrils and a simple long mouth line ending in a tiny fork. Heavy dark brown hand-drawn outline, subtly wobbly and uneven, charmingly lopsided anatomical shortcuts as if someone quickly doodled it with an unsteady thick marker. Flat solid tan body fill; at most ONE flat slightly darker muzzle patch. No gradients, lighting, highlights, glossy rendering, detailed fur, airbrush shading or polished chibi-game styling. The roughness comes from simple proportions and uneven contour strokes, not dirt/noise/blur. Maintain a clearly recognizable capybara with round ears and a broad blunt muzzle; never cat features. This deliberately crude simplistic flat cartoon must still be legible at 48px.
Composition: EXACTLY 8 columns by 7 rows, 56 fully visible separate complete animal drawings, one whole character per equal grid cell, all of the same design and scale. Transparent alpha background everywhere outside the animal, no floor/shadows, no props, human hands, hats, accessories, hearts, text, grid lines or labels. Generous transparent gutters between EVERY row and column, and a clear transparent border around the entire atlas. Ensure there are no animal parts in adjoining cells. All 56 animals are complete with intact ears and paws, and maintain the same cell-relative foot baseline. Keep eight animation poses per row in this exact order:
Row 1 IDLE: slow squat sitting and breathing, tiny almost imperceptible blink, front or three-quarter FRONT view, vacant high-set dash eyes, wide long face and massive bean body dominate.
Row 2 WALK: facing right or three-quarter right, eight distinct quadruped walk frames with alternate tiny feet, slow lumbering awkward walk.
Row 3 RUN: facing right, eight frames of a funny lumbering quadruped run with alternating collected/extended stubby feet, always the same vacant eyes and face, never an excited determined expression.
Row 4 ASCENDING JUMP: eight airborne poses leaning clearly UP toward upper right, front feet raised and hind feet tucked/trailing down, distinct from run. Even airborne it looks completely clueless.
Row 5 DESCENDING FALL: first four frames lean clearly DOWN toward lower right with front feet reaching for landing, last four gradually become a soft squat landing; visibly different from jump or run. Blank unimpressed face remains.
Row 6 PETTED: tiny head lean, understated closed horizontal dash eyes, very slight contentment but mostly vacant placid face, no cheek blush or sparkle or big smile.
Row 7 HELD: upright dangling wide body, small forefeet and hind feet wiggling, no human hand, still calmly oblivious with tiny dash eyes.
Technical: regular 8:7 rectangular atlas, ideally 1536×1344 or 1024×896. Maintain exactly 56 complete animals, eight per each of seven rows, with genuine alpha transparency. Preserve animation action order and matching frame scale; change all seven actions to this simple dopey marker-doodle drawing style.

An unmistakable real CAPYBARA made into a cute chibi mascot: warm caramel-brown short fur, a broad rectangular rounded BLUNT MUZZLE, two SMALL ROUND ears high on the head, calm small dark eyes, broad brown nostrils, stocky barrel-shaped body, SHORT strong legs with simple little toes, NO visible tail. No feline features, no pointed cat ears, no feline nose, no long tail, no stripes, no whiskers, no mane. Preserve capybara proportions while fitting the existing adorable outlined sprite style. The muzzle and round ears must remain unmistakable in ALL 56 drawings.
